claims.claim: Severian was Bishop of Gabala in Syria.
Severian was a popular preacher in Constantinople from around 400 until 404.
Severian became the enemy of John Chrysostom and helped condemn him at the Synod of the Oak.
Severian was regarded by his contemporaries as a good preacher and was known as the author of Biblical commentaries and sermons.
The fragments survive in catena manuscripts, including Vaticanus gr. 2217.
Almost all of Severian's homilies survive in Greek only among the works of his enemy Chrysostom.
